baseline_models.focus_anchor: The address to those who have trusted is followed immediately by the twice-spoken imperative to obey, once with God and once with the messenger.
baseline_models.mechanism: Settled trust supplies an interior condition in which command can become willing alignment. Repeating the obedience verb preserves two relations inside one movement: orientation to divine authority and practical alignment with its commissioned bearer.

activation_trace.role: Security and trusted repose supply the inward steadiness from which the commanded alignment can proceed.
Yielding to command gives the repeated imperatives their basic movement of enacted compliance.
Accord and responsive correspondence sharpen obedience from passive submission into coordinated alignment.

changed_reading.before: The verse repeats a general demand for submission.
changed_reading.after: The verse converts trusted security into coordinated action while keeping divine authority and messenger-mediated enactment distinct but coupled.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The prohibition uses an active causative verb with 'your works' as its direct object.
baseline_models.mechanism: A purposeful deed can be made to lose truth, stability, and effect. The wording therefore locates danger after or within action, not only in failure to act: agents can actively turn performed work into something void.

activation_trace.role: Loss of truth and stability supplies the state into which works are forbidden to be driven.
Active removal or corruption makes the addressees possible causal agents of their works' undoing.
Intentional action is the vulnerable product whose reality and efficacy must be preserved.

changed_reading.before: The closing clause warns vaguely that good deeds may be cancelled.
changed_reading.after: It warns that agents can causally strip their own intentional work of truth, stability, or operative effect.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The second obedience imperative terminates in 'the messenger' and is followed by the prohibition concerning works.
baseline_models.mechanism: The messenger is both dispatched bearer and carrier of a saying. Obedience is the relay that lets the carried message be put to work; severing reception from enactment leaves a message heard but not operationalized.

activation_trace.role: Dispatch and release frame the messenger as a commissioned movement from source toward recipients.
The carrier and carried saying supply the transmissive middle between authority and action.
Putting something into operation makes works the enacted terminus of the transmitted command.

changed_reading.before: The messenger is simply a second authority named beside God.
changed_reading.after: The messenger functions as the commissioned transmission through which divine command becomes operable work.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated root of obedience also carries images of ability, taking ability upon oneself, and the self making an act easy.
baseline_models.mechanism: The command can be heard as demanding cultivation of executability, not assent alone. One must make room, capacity, and inward readiness for command to become intentional action; otherwise obedience remains nominal and work is vulnerable to nullification.

activation_trace.role: Ability and power to perform expose practical capacity as one layer within the obedience field.
Taking ability upon oneself contributes the effort of making a difficult command executable.
The self's facilitation supplies an inward mechanism by which command becomes easy enough to enter action.
Purposeful action is the test of whether claimed readiness has become actual capacity.

changed_reading.before: Obedience is an inward yes followed automatically by action.
changed_reading.after: Obedience includes the work of becoming able and inwardly ready to carry command into purposeful action.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening sequence makes works go astray when agents turn others from a traversable way, then contrasts following falsehood with following truth. Work therefore inherits the direction of the path and object it follows; nullification is directional corruption before it is quantitative loss.

activation_trace.role: Turning away and diverting supply the action that dislocates work from its proper course.
A traversable extended road supplies the directional medium in which work can remain aligned or be diverted.
Straying from guidance describes the resulting misorientation of the works themselves.
Following behind gives works an inherited direction from the false or true object being followed.
Falsehood's lack of truth and stability names the destination that can make aligned-looking work void.
The focus verse anchors the directional model in the addressees' own intentional deeds.

structural_cues: 47:1 opens the surah with diverted works, 47:3 mirrors following falsehood and following truth, and 47:33 turns that pattern into a direct prohibition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies road, diversion, straying, and paired following; I infer that works take their validity from orientation along that route. A live alternative is that each passage states an independent judgment without a shared directional mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Works are valid or invalid chiefly by their visible content or accumulated amount.
changed_reading.after: Works can be nullified by being routed behind falsehood and away from the way, even while substantial activity continues.

context_deltas.mechanism: Testing both abrades and reveals. The repeated test language culminates in testing the addressees' reports or inward news, so works become evidentiary surfaces whose behavior under pressure discloses what lies beneath them.

activation_trace.role: Testing that makes a condition appear supplies the early disclosure mechanism.
Wear and abrasion contribute a material image for pressure removing a merely presentable surface.
The repeated test makes hidden quality observable rather than merely imposing hardship.
Knowledge of a report and an affair's interior makes the tested output disclose an inward reality.
Intentional works are the focus-anchored surfaces whose tested endurance can testify to intention.

structural_cues: Testing appears near the opening and again immediately before 47:32-33, where tested reports, collapsed works, and the prohibition form a tightening sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies testing, wear, disclosure, and inward report; I infer that deeds function as testimony whose composition becomes legible under pressure. The alternative is that 'reports' means outward conduct generally and does not make every work evidentiary.

changed_reading.before: The prohibition protects a stored total of completed deeds.
changed_reading.after: It protects the testimonial integrity of deeds that will be worn, pressured, and made to reveal the agent's interior condition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated collapse of works follows inward aversion, while the collapse-root carries the image of a belly swelling from harmful intake. Null work may therefore retain impressive volume: it has consumed what cannot nourish it and expands toward failure rather than fruit.

activation_trace.role: Aversion opposed to willing approval supplies the toxic inward relation to what was sent down.
Bodily swelling after harmful consumption supplies the deceptive enlargement that ends in collapse.
The verse explicitly makes intentional works the object of this collapse process.
Falling and sinking give the swollen process its terminal loss of standing.
Loss of stability anchors the bodily image back in the focus prohibition's explicit nullification.

structural_cues: 47:9 and 47:28 repeat an aversion-following-collapse pattern around works, making inward appetite or repugnance more than incidental affect.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies aversion, harmful swelling, falling, and works; I infer an intake-to-inflation-to-collapse arrow. The materially live alternative is simple cancellation with the swelling branch serving only as etymological color.

changed_reading.before: Nullification means that works disappear or are subtracted.
changed_reading.after: Works may remain bulky and impressive while aversive intake makes them internally unnourished, swollen, and headed toward collapse.

context_deltas.mechanism: A nominal declaration of obedience and recognized speech is placed against the moment when the affair becomes resolved. At that transition, truth must move from saying into fulfilled action; otherwise verbal obedience generates no durable work.

activation_trace.role: Named obedience supplies the professed stance whose practical truth is about to be tested.
The heart's firm binding and decisive cutting mark the point where speech must become commitment.
Fulfilling word in deed supplies the conversion from claimed obedience to verified action.
The doubled focus imperative reissues obedience as enacted compliance after the earlier performative failure.

structural_cues: 47:20 portrays desire for a revealed surah followed by a deathlike gaze when fighting is mentioned; 47:21 then opposes spoken obedience to the resolved affair.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies request, recoil, professed obedience, resolve, and fulfilled truth; I infer that the focus prohibition targets the speech-action break. An alternative is that 47:21 concerns sincerity narrowly while 47:33 gives an independent general command.

changed_reading.before: Saying and recognizing the command substantially constitute obedience.
changed_reading.after: Obedience is proved only when recognized speech survives the instant an affair hardens into costly, executable decision.

context_deltas.mechanism: Turning away produces corruption, severed kinship, and then hearts closed against deliberating consequences. Work can thus remain as isolated acts while its connective and receptive system is disabled; nullification is social and cognitive disconnection, not mere nonperformance.

activation_trace.role: Cutting connection supplies the relational operation that makes otherwise present acts sterile.
Kinship gives the work a living social network that can be cut apart.
Considering an affair's outcome supplies the receptive reasoning needed to keep action coherent over time.
Closure and hardening disable the heart's ability to receive and integrate what should guide work.
Interpersonal dealing anchors the severance mechanism in a branch of the focus verse's own works.

structural_cues: 47:22-24 moves from turning away to social severance, sensory failure, and locked hearts before the sequence returns to obedience and works.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies severed relations, blocked deliberation, and interpersonal work; I infer that connection is part of a deed's operative integrity. A live alternative is that these are neighboring consequences of disobedience rather than mechanisms of nullification.

changed_reading.before: A deed remains intact so long as the individual act was completed.
changed_reading.after: A deed can be nullified while still visibly present if it severs the relations and receptive judgment that let it function as coherent work.

context_deltas.mechanism: After guidance becomes clear, retreat is made attractive and extended time permits the counterfeit to settle. The self's ability to facilitate an act therefore cannot by itself identify obedience; ease must be tested by the authority and direction to which it yields.

activation_trace.role: The self's or adversary's beautification of an act supplies a counterfeit form of inward facilitation.
Extended time gives the made-easy retreat room to feel normal and sustainable.
The self making an affair easy is the focus-side image now qualified as morally ambiguous.

structural_cues: 47:25 locates the attractive facilitation after guidance has become clear and immediately before the exposure of partial, secret obedience.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies clarified guidance, embellished retreat, delay, and self-facilitation; I infer that felt ease can mimic obedience. The alternative is that the focus's obedience root should not import the reflexive self-facilitation branch at all.

changed_reading.before: Inward ease and readiness are reliable evidence that one has become obedient.
changed_reading.after: Ease is only capacity: it becomes obedience when aligned with God and messenger, but can equally smooth retreat from clarified guidance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The promise to obey another party in part of the affair partitions allegiance and hides that allocation inside. Against it, the focus repeats obedience with both God and messenger and then forbids work-nullification: divided jurisdiction is a mechanism by which outwardly compliant work loses integrity.

activation_trace.role: Promised compliance supplies an obedience-form redirected toward a rival audience.
Partition into a portion supplies the internal division of the affair and of allegiance.
Concealment in the interior makes the rival allocation compatible with an outward obedient appearance.
The doubled focus command restores unpartitioned enacted alignment to God and messenger.
The commissioned bearer fixes the legitimate human relay against the hidden rival audience.

structural_cues: The exact promise 'we will obey you in part of the affair' occurs in 47:26, and its hidden character is named before 47:33 answers with two explicit obedience objects.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rival obedience, partition, secrecy, and the later doubled command; I infer that the repetition rejects compartmentalized allegiance. A live alternative is that the second obedience verb only clarifies grammar and does not answer the earlier partition.

changed_reading.before: One may preserve obedience by complying selectively in public while allocating other parts of an affair elsewhere.
changed_reading.after: Selective and hidden partition of allegiance can nullify work from within; the doubled command insists on an integrated line of obedience.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus, opposition to the messenger is imaged as a group splitting through disagreement, followed by works falling or collapsing. The command to obey the messenger is therefore also anti-fissure maintenance: splitting from the relay destabilizes the work produced by the group and its members.

activation_trace.role: A community cracking open through disagreement supplies the social mechanism of opposition.
The commissioned carrier is the concrete relay from which the fissure breaks away.
Falling and sinking supply the terminal collapse of works after the split.
Intentional works are explicitly the objects destabilized by opposition.
Responsive accord in the focus verse acts as the positive counterforce to schismatic opposition.

structural_cues: 47:32 and 47:33 are adjacent mirror sequences: oppose messenger then works collapse; obey messenger then do not nullify works.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fissure, messenger-opposition, collapse, and the adjacent reversal; I infer a causal anti-fissure function for obedience. The alternative is a legal sequence in which opposition and cancellation are linked without a social-cohesion mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Obedience concerns each individual's relation to command, and work-loss is an individual accounting event.
changed_reading.after: Obedience also holds a commissioned collective together; schism from the messenger is a mechanism that makes shared and individual work collapse.

context_deltas.mechanism: The verse after the focus denies that God will deprive the addressees of their works, and the next names work-compensation. This creates asymmetric agency: people can ruin the claim embodied in their work, but God is not the defrauding party and does not arbitrarily shave its due.

activation_trace.role: Deprivation that takes away a right or work supplies the precise loss that is denied of God.
The wage or due of labor lets work carry a claim rather than function only as an abstract moral score.
Compensation for work confirms the payable dimension of preserved deeds.
Active corruption in the focus is assigned to the warned agents rather than to an arbitrary divine subtraction.

structural_cues: 47:33 forbids the addressees to void their works; 47:35 promises that God will not deprive those works; 47:36 follows with compensation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies self-directed prohibition, denied deprivation, and compensation; I infer asymmetric agency and a claim-like value in work. The alternative is that the sequence reassures about reward without distinguishing causal responsibility for invalidation.

changed_reading.before: The prohibition mainly threatens that God may cancel accumulated merit.
changed_reading.after: The warning concerns self-caused destruction of work's valid claim, while the following promise explicitly excludes God as a party who defrauds that work.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing sequence contrasts diversion with expenditure, then says withholding rebounds upon the self and permits replacement of the withholding group. Work remains alive by passing from call through the agent into costly circulation; stopping that passage nullifies the caller's own participation.

activation_trace.role: Being occupied away from a thing supplies the diversion that interrupts purposeful passage into action.
The outward movement of wealth supplies the concrete costly circulation demanded by the call.
A through-passage with an exit supplies the spatial mechanism by which possession becomes effective expenditure.
Withholding blocks the outward passage and thereby arrests the work before it reaches its object.
The very self makes the blockage reflexive: withheld passage deprives the agent's own participation.
One thing standing in another's place supplies the system's ability to continue by replacing a blocked agent.
Interpersonal dealing anchors circulation in the focus verse's own field of work.

structural_cues: 47:36-38 moves from diversion, to compensation, to a call for expenditure, to reflexive withholding, and finally to replacement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies diversion, outflow, passage, withholding, self, and substitution; I infer a circulation model in which work must traverse the agent. The alternative is that these verses concern wealth alone and only illustrate, rather than define, non-null work.

changed_reading.before: Preserving works means retaining what the agent has already accumulated.
changed_reading.after: Preserving work can require letting a call pass through the self into costly circulation; withholding arrests the work and makes the agent replaceable.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it joins the blood-forfeit branch of the focus verb to slain persons' preserved work and the later language of vengeance or deprivation. It remains anchored in the explicit nullification verb, works, killing, and denied deprivation; downstream prose should render it as a legal-material analogy, not as a lexical replacement or a doctrine of literal blood payment.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus nullification root includes blood going forfeit without vengeance or compensation, while its object is work that can also carry a laborer's due.

activation_trace.role: Blood lost without enforceable recompense supplies the image of value made forfeit.
A laborer's wage makes the focus object capable of being pictured as a claim with a due.
Actual loss of life supplies the context in which the surah explicitly refuses to lose the slain persons' works.
A blood-claim seeking redress keeps the legal image of an outstanding due alive.
Deprivation of right or work states the loss that the verse denies God will impose.

changed_reading.before: A nullified deed is merely removed from an account.
changed_reading.after: A deed may be pictured as a claim whose value must not be made forfeit like unredressed blood, while God guarantees not to deprive it of its due.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is cross-domain because it activates the rare 'trodden road' branch inside works and materializes nullification as an obstructed route. It remains anchored in the focus noun and the surah's repeated path-diversion pattern; downstream prose should mark it as a spatial model for efficacy, not claim that 'works' ordinarily means roads here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus noun for works includes a well-traveled road, allowing the prohibition to be spatialized as keeping one's work traversable.

activation_trace.role: A worked, trodden road turns the addressees' works into a route whose usability can be preserved or lost.
Idleness and loss of usefulness supply the route's disabled condition.
The extended traversable way supplies the larger path into which a work-road should connect.
A mountain barrier materializes diversion as an obstruction that makes a route unusable.

changed_reading.before: Works are discrete objects that are either retained or erased.
changed_reading.after: Works can be imagined as traveled routes: obedience keeps them connected and passable, while diversion and idling turn them into blocked roads.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The agricultural image is surprising because the focus form ordinarily signals obedience, while the cited branch concerns pasture and fruit becoming available. It remains licensed by the same focus root and is sharpened by the context's harmful-feeding collapse; downstream prose should retain it only as an ecological analogy for readiness and yield.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The doubled obedience root includes pasture opening for grazing and fruit reaching gatherable maturity.

activation_trace.role: Pasture becoming available and fruit becoming gatherable picture obedience as a condition ripened for use.
Purposeful work supplies the yield expected from the ripened condition.
Harmful feeding that produces swelling rather than nourishment supplies the failed ecological counterprocess.

changed_reading.before: Obedience is a punctual response made after a command arrives.
changed_reading.after: Obedience may also be pictured as ripening the field of agency until work becomes available for right use, while bad intake can produce bulk without yield.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is the most form-distant activation because it uses the packet's non-dominant mapping from the obedience root to an upright column. It remains inspectably anchored in both repeated focus occurrences and their distinct objects; downstream prose should present it only as an architectural afterimage of the repetition, never as the lexical meaning of the imperatives.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus repeats the same root in two positions, and the packet's split inventory offers an image of an erected supporting column.

activation_trace.role: An upright house-support turns the two obedience occurrences into paired structural bearings.
The worshipped divine object fixes one bearing at the source of authority.
The carrier of the saying fixes the other bearing at commissioned transmission.
Corruption or removal supplies the collapse that the paired support image resists.

changed_reading.before: The repeated verb is rhetorical emphasis with no independent spatial force.
changed_reading.after: As a contained architectural image, the two obedience clauses act like paired supports holding work between divine source and messenger transmission so it does not collapse.

strongest_changes: Work-nullification became directional: activity can persist while following falsehood and leaving the traversable way.
The sequence from professed obedience to resolved command made the speech-action transition the decisive test of truth.
Partial secret obedience and immediate messenger-opposition exposed partition and schism as mechanisms of work-collapse.
The promise that God will not deprive works, followed by compensation, shifted the warning away from arbitrary divine cancellation toward self-caused destruction of a valid claim.
Testing, withholding, and replacement made works disclose the interior and remain alive only when command passes through the agent into costly action.
summary.what_was_special: The focus prohibition did not settle into one accounting model. It held together directional, performative, social, evidentiary, economic, bodily, ecological, and architectural readings, with the strangest branches retained under explicit containment rather than audited away.
remaining_uncertainties: The causative prohibition clearly assigns agency to the addressees, but it remains open how directly that agency maps onto eventual divine judgment of the works.
The bodily swelling branch of collapse may supply a full mechanism of deceptive abundance or only vivid lexical coloring.
The claim-and-wage reading is strongly sequenced by 47:35-36, but its legal force should not be overstated beyond the text's denial of deprivation.
The non-dominant upright-support mapping is packet-licensed and structurally suggestive, yet too form-distant to survive without overt qualification.
